## Changed

- The release archive ships the OCR models, so `structured --ocr scans`
  works out of the box. They sit in `ocr-models/` beside the executable,
  where the binary finds them the way it finds PDFium; `--ocr-models` and
  `PDF_TOOLKIT_OCR_MODELS` still take precedence when set. `build.sh` fetches
  them into `dist/ocr-models` with the freshly built binary's own
  `ocr-models` command (only the files missing, every checksum verified), so a
  build needs the network once, as it already does for PDFium. The archive
  grows by about 14 MB. Without `--ocr` nothing changes.

## Notes

- `serve`: an OCR job peaks at about 1.1 GiB, above the default
  `--worker-memory-mib 1024`, so the service stops it as over its limit. Where
  the service runs OCR, set `--worker-memory-mib 2048`
  (`PDF_TOOLKIT_WORKER_MEMORY_MIB` under PM2).
- A binary run through a symlink on macOS finds neither PDFium nor the models
  beside it; run it by its real path.
